findings.ac: `nw worker info --json` prints the documented keys
findings.title: Plain (non-JSON) `nw worker info` output is untested
findings.detail: Only `info --json` is tested. The plain `key: value` path in cli_worker.worker_info is never run. It is cosmetic and outside the AC.

findings.ac: `nw worker ssh-command` execs the four allowed subcommands and refuses everything else
findings.title: ssh-command is only tested in-process, never through the click command
findings.detail: test_worker_ssh_command.py calls W.ssh_command(environ) directly. No test runs `nw worker ssh-command` as a subprocess with SSH_ORIGINAL_COMMAND set to a refused command to check exit 2 at the CLI layer, so the `raise SystemExit(...)` wiring is unverified. The risk is low.

findings.ac: Two concurrent gate-jobs for the same repo_key with different base.sha
findings.title: The concurrent-jobs gate busy-polls with `sleep 0.1` in shell
findings.detail: The rendezvous loop in test_concurrent_jobs_see_their_own_base polls the sync dir with `sleep 0.1`. It is bounded by the gate's 60 s timeout and the test pins slots: 2, but it still relies on a wall-clock wait under load. Accepted flakiness risk.
